summary: Cellebrite DI Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K attaching its third-quarter 2026 earnings press release, not a special-situation event. Reported total ARR of $528.5 million (up 20% year-over-year), revenue of $149.0 million (up 18%), subscription revenue of $134.9 million, GAAP net income of $26.7 million, non-GAAP net income of $45.6 million, adjusted EBITDA of $53.6 million (36.0% margin) and diluted GAAP EPS of $0.10. Management also reiterated mid-September plans for a U.S. redomiciliation via a new U.S. parent, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals; no transaction terms, advisor, premium or timetable were disclosed. Watch approval mechanics and index-inclusion implications of the reorganization.
